name: xenaxio-desktop
description: Xenaxio and XenRooms for the desktop (based on Bulwark Desktop)
author: Xenaxio

scripts.test: node build.mjs --test && node scripts/build-native.mjs --optional && playwright test
scripts.pack:dir: node build.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs --optional && electron-builder --config scripts/xenaxio-builder-config.cjs --dir
scripts.dist:win: node build.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs --optional && node scripts/build-nsis-splash.mjs && electron-builder --config scripts/xenaxio-builder-config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node build.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs --optional && electron-builder --config scripts/xenaxio-builder-config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node build.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs --optional && electron-builder --config scripts/xenaxio-builder-config.cjs --linux --publish never
